basis: Owner explicitly requests fixing the simultaneous two authorization pages
directCause: Fixed codex login calls webbrowser::open; the host subsequently calls its own opener with the URL from that same process
logic: These are two real producers of the same browser action. Assigning browser opening solely to the existing host removes the duplicate without modifying the CLI or introducing timing guesses.

reference.参照: 先查 gogo-party accounts.ts 的 loginEnv、PROVIDER_LOGIN 与 createLineSink：当前也同时保留 CLI 自开页与房间开页，不照搬该重复。查询 NaveHQ 的现有 OAuth/container 记录及 LoomOS 源码/规格，没有找到适用于本次 Windows 单次开页的控制。再读仓库 parts/substrate 拆解、execution-layer-capability-table、reuse-blueprint 与 upstream-reference-map，以及已带入的 t3code app-server schema。最后核官方登录文档和固定 rust-v0.149.0 login、app-server account processor、其固定 webbrowser 1.2.4 Windows 源码。采用已验证的官方结构化 account/login/start 路径和现有原 Job/pipe；不自创 BROWSER 环境开关、CLI patch、注册表改动、拦截、等待或重试。

implementation: Same fixed CLI app-server, ordinary same-user login; one account/login/start chatgpt, returned authUrl opened only by host; original loginId matching and original Job/durable stop; original LPAC account/read determines final state
